Crystal Lake hides six Friday the 13th Easter eggs you probably missed!
Number one! The opening title recreates the glass-shattering design from the original 1980 movie!
Number two! Pamela wears the same light-blue sweater associated with Mrs. Voorhees in the original film!
Number three! The snake scene reverses a notorious moment from the first movie. This time, the snake survives!
Number four! Episode five recreates the boathouse scene from the original Friday the 13th almost shot for shot!
Number five! Jason wears the burlap sack from Friday the 13th Part 2, before he ever adopted that famous hockey mask!
Number six! Listen carefully. That iconic horror sound returns throughout the series!
